x_text: Reply to a WhatsApp enquiry inside a minute, even if the full answer takes longer. A short line that says you saw it keeps the customer from messaging the next shop on their list.
linkedin_text:
A WhatsApp enquiry is easy to lose in the first hour, before anyone answers the real question.

Picture a furniture shop on a Saturday. A customer asks on WhatsApp whether the grey sofa is still available, then sends the same message to three other shops. In that picture, the shop that replies first gets the visit.

Five replies make that first hour easier to handle:
1. Confirm you saw the message and say when the full answer will come.
2. Ask one question so you send the right options, not a list of questions.
3. Answer the price in the chat, so they do not have to call to find it.
4. Offer two call times to pick from instead of asking when suits them.
5. If the chat goes quiet, send one short nudge the next morning and then leave it.

None of this needs new software. It needs the five messages written down once, so whoever holds the phone sends the same replies.

The full scripts are in our Instagram carousel this week. Save them for the next busy Saturday.
